verdict.rationale: Convertio's API pricing page covers all three dimensions, listing "Unlimited* file size, Unlimited maximum conversion time per file, Unlimited concurrent conversions," and the web UI states a 1 GB maximum file size for anonymous users. The asterisk on "Unlimited" is never explained, so the real ceiling stays undocumented. There is also no tier-by-tier breakdown for the free or lower API tiers or for rate limits, which makes it hard to size jobs. Missing for 10: definition of the "Unlimited*" caveat, per-tier API file-size/duration/concurrency limits, documented API rate limits, independent corroboration.
